rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00021567, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1100, seed=43, rationale=iter-16 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). PIVOT: characterize the STABLE bs=2 champion (iter-7 c24/ep5/bs2/lr2.16e-4, hr 0.8469) instead of the high-variance bs=1 line. ONE KNOB: seed 42 -> 43 (bs=2 seed replicate). All else = iter-7 exactly (itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=2.16e-4, epochs=5, batch_size=2, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) bs=1 line is HIGH-VARIANCE: iter-12 s42 0.8638, iter-14 s43 0.7983, iter-15 s44 0.6142 -> mean 0.759 +/- 0.104. Both iter-14 and iter-15 logs CONFIRM all 5 epochs completed (train loss converged to 1e-6 in every run) yet val hr swung 0.25 across seeds. KEY FINDING: with an IDENTICAL, converged train loss the val hr varies enormously -> the bs=1 single-sample gradients drive end-to-end unrolled training to different minima that generalize very differently; 0.8638 was a FAVORABLE-SEED win, not a robust champion. (2) FAILURE MODE: bs=1 = high generalization variance. The bs=2 champion (iter-7, 0.8469) trained more stably and finished comfortably in budget (15.7min, no wall risk). Need bs=2 seed replicates to test whether bs=2 is the more ROBUST (reportable) champion. (3) ONE KNOB: seed 42 -> 43 at the iter-7 bs=2 config. (4) HYPOTHESIS: bs=2 hr at seed 43 stays within ~+/-0.02 of 0.8469 (tight spread), confirming bs=2 as the stable champion whose mean the leaderboard should report -- even though its single-best point (0.8469) is below bs=1's lucky 0.8638. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if bs=2 also swings >0.05, the whole itnet_v3 breast recipe is high-variance and the reported number must be a multi-seed mean with a wide std, not any single peak. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): iter-7 bs2 config = 939.5s = 15.7min, ~4min margin -> no wall risk (unlike the bs=1 line at 19.85-20.6min). max_train_s=1100 fences the TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-16 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-17.
